description_zh: Waymo AV 在 stop sign 处停止，后方皮卡追尾。选皮卡为 ego，测试其能否及时刹停。

source_snippets: The Waymo AV was traveling eastbound on 4th Street and stopped at a stop sign at the intersection of S. June Street when a pick-up truck approached the Waymo AV from behind and made contact with the rear of the Waymo AV.
MOVEMENT PRECEDING COLLISION: A. STOPPED: VEH 1 (X); B. PROCEEDING STRAIGHT: VEH 2 (X)
TYPE OF COLLISION: C. REAR END: VEH 2 (X)
evidence.reason: AV 静止在 stop sign 前，皮卡从后方直行追尾。皮卡是唯一移动的 car，选为 ego，AV 作为同车道前方静止 NPC。
